notes.title: Pokémon adventure — Pokédex image preference
notes.text: Choose Artwork or Sprite in Pokémon Settings → Appearance. Static front sprites apply to the Pokédex list, species details and form references; party portraits and battle image selection stay independent. The preference belongs to the character and survives new chats, replies and reloads. Uses indexed exact-form front sprites, with exact artwork fallback on image failures.
